subject: NeonLane: Redwood onboarding pairing and session confirmation
messages:
From: Caroline Fischer <caroline.f@neonlane.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 08:42:00 +0200
Subject: NeonLane Redwood onboarding — compact session request

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the product intro last week. We’d like to get a compact, hands-on Redwood onboarding for our payments platform team (12 people, split across engineering and ops). Ideally we want a mix of console walkthrough (keys, routing policies, model catalog) and a short API enablement portion focusing on tokenization/embedding calls.

Constraints: most of the engineering team is CET (GMT+2), prefer afternoons between 14:00–17:00 CET. We’d like a single 90-minute session if possible — otherwise two 60-minute blocks.

Proposed windows next week:
- Tue Jul 9, 14:00–15:30 CET
- Wed Jul 10, 15:00–16:30 CET
- Thu Jul 11, 16:00–17:30 CET

Attached is a short ramp plan and our attendee list. Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood can handle a quick lab exercise for API keys + sandbox quotas?

Thanks,

Caroline Fischer
Head of Integrations, NeonLane
caroline.f@neonlane.com
--Attachment: neonlane-ramp-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 85KB)

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jul 2028 09:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: NeonLane Redwood onboarding — compact session request

Hi Caroline — great to hear you want to get the team into a hands-on session. We can absolutely run a compact 90-minute pairing that covers console flows and a focused API lab.

Quick notes:
- We can offer Tue Jul 9, 14:00–15:30 CET or Wed Jul 10, 15:00–16:30 CET. Thu at 16:00 clashes with another reserved trainer slot but we can try to free it if needed.
- For the API lab we’ll provision sandbox credentials and a short prework checklist (attached). Please confirm one week out who needs admin vs. dev access so we set quotas correctly.
- Who are the 2–3 attendees that will be responsible for long-term platform integration? We’ll allocate extra Q&A time for them.

I’ve attached the prework checklist and included a short runbook for the lab. If either proposed window works, I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link and the session runbook.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com

--Attachment: redwood-session-runbook.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)
